::: {#sol-enrollment}

1. True: "every student takes some course".
   Ana takes 201, Ben takes 241, and Cy takes 201.
2. False: "some course is taken by every student".
   Ben does not take 201, Cy does not take 241, and Ana does not take 247.
3. True: "every course has some student".
   Ana takes 201 and 241, and Cy takes 247.
4. False: "some student takes every course".
   Ana does not take 247, Ben does not take 201, and Cy does not take 241.

Parts 1 and 2 use the same quantifiers and the same predicate in a different order,
and they have different truth values.

:::
